html:
The national poet of Romania, born in Moldavia in 1850. He died in Bucharest in 1889.

He left home young to travel with theatre troupes, then studied in Vienna and Berlin. His poems appeared in the journal of Junimea, a literary society in Iași whose leader, the critic Titu Maiorescu, championed him. From 1877 he worked as a journalist in Bucharest, writing sharp articles for a conservative paper.

His poems blend romantic longing, folk song, nature and philosophy, with a music that set the standard for written Romanian. His long poem Luceafărul (The Evening Star), about a star who loves a mortal girl, is the best known. He wrote at the time when Moldavia and Wallachia had united and Romania won full independence in the war of 1877 and 1878, and his work became part of the new nation's identity.

Only one book of his poems came out in his lifetime, in 1883. That year he fell mentally ill, and he died six years later at 39.
sum: The national poet of Romania, born in Moldavia in 1850. He died in Bucharest in 1889.
